homeTitle: A little care for your island.
homeDescription: Organize your pockets, look after your island, and make every edit clear.
dropHint: Save folder, main.dat, or ZIP archive
howTitle: Your first edit, in three steps
step1Body: Choose an exported save folder or main.dat. Keep its companion files together.
step2Body: Choose a player, select a slot, and edit with clear controls.
step3Body: Edits stay in memory until you save. Automatic backups follow your existing settings.
localNote: Files are processed on this computer.
recent: Pick up where you left off
noRecent: Your most recent save will appear here.
playerHint: Manage your balances. Names and advanced settings are available in the original editor.
applied: Changes applied. Save to file when ready.
inventoryHint: Select a slot to inspect or replace an item. Changes can be undone.
searchInventory: Find an item in this inventory
selectSlotHint: Select an item or an empty slot to begin.
quantityHint: The limit follows this item's stack size.
catalogHint: Search by localized item name. Select a result, then apply it to the slot.
toolsTitle: More ways to care for your island
toolsHint: These tools open in the original editor while the new workspace grows.
legacyHint: Includes player names, island settings, imports, exports and console connection. Opening it starts a new undo history.
busy: Another operation is in progress. Please try again.
operationFailed: The operation could not be completed.
invalidRequest: Check the values and selected slot, then try again.
unsavedPrompt: Save your changes before leaving? Yes saves, No discards, Cancel keeps editing.
runtimeMissing: The new workspace could not start. Install Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, or use the original editor below.
missingAssets: Workspace files are missing. Rebuild the app with npm and the .NET SDK.
offlinePreview: Browser preview · open NHSE on Windows to edit real saves.
overviewHint: Choose what you would like to work on. Your existing island tools are always nearby.
keyHints: Ctrl+S save · Ctrl+Z undo · F11 full screen
